caption: The drawing depicts a vertical composition featuring a central figure surrounded by various abstract and organic shapes, all set against a densely textured brown background. At the top center, there is a circular emblem outlined in red, filled with light brown and containing a yellow cross-like symbol. Below this emblem is a larger oval-shaped form also outlined in red, enclosing a vertical, stylized shape that resembles a totem or figure, primarily colored in yellow, with accents of gray, blue, and orange, and detailed with green and white areas around its edges. The head of this figure is decorated with a fringe of small, radiating yellow and red lines. Around the central figure inside the oval, there are additional abstract forms and shapes colored in teal, red, and white. To the right within the background, an irregular form outlined in red and shaded in gray appears alongside other flowing white shapes. At the base of the central figure, another abstract element is present in orange, red, and yellow, extending towards the right. The composition is bordered by a wide margin of plain, off-white paper. The overall color palette includes prominent use of yellow, orange, red, teal, gray, white, and brown.
title: Petroglyph
